result:
I made all three fixes, but I haven't run any tests, typecheck or lint, and I didn't render any of the three surfaces.

- **Duplicate closes the sidebar:** in `frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightLogic.tsx`, `duplicateInsight` now calls `setScenePanelOpen(false)` just before it navigates to the copy. It only does this when it redirects, and only after the copy is created, so a failed duplicate leaves the panel open. This only closes the panel when it was opened manually. If it is open through the side panel's Info tab, it stays open, and I didn't try to handle that case.
- **Back on the transfer page:** the transfer route only carries the numeric insight ID, and no insight route accepts that. `resourceTransferLogic.ts` now loads the insight's short ID on mount. It uses `insightsApi.getByNumericId`, and only for insights. `ResourceTransfer.tsx` builds the Back link with `urls.insightView(shortId)`. If the short ID hasn't loaded yet, or can't be found, Back goes to the saved insights list. I edited the logic's hand-written type block by hand instead of regenerating it.
- **Subscriptions empty-state card:** in `SubscriptionOverviewComponents.tsx`, the featured card is now a container-query container. The illustration is hidden below the `@sm` container width. The text and button then take the full width, which also fits the `@container` width rather than the viewport, so it responds to the modal's width. The compact variant is unchanged.

I didn't add tests. The existing `insightLogic` tests may need a look, since `duplicateInsight` now dispatches a new action.
